buttonizationNotes:
decorateButtons() buttonizes any

whose only content is one link (no / needed); strong → primary, em → secondary, both → accent; breadcrumb and image links are skipped; an authored link title that differs from the text also becomes aria-label (the title is kept); no title is derived from the link text; p.image-caption marks an -only paragraph right after an image paragraph (markImageCaptions in decorateMain)
sectionMetadata: project-owned applySectionMetadata(): style rows → classes on the section, metadata block removed, empty wrappers dropped (after decorateSections, before decorateBlocks)

sectionStyles.separator: empty section, style `separator` → 1px #ebebeb rule, 64px above/below, inside the 1136px content box
sectionStyles.no-gutter: the 1164px cap on the section (>=1025), wrappers max-width none + no 14px padding (source .cmp-container without aem-Grid gutters)
sectionStyles.plain-title: no 84px underline on the section's default-content h1/h2 (source plain .cmp-title)
sectionStyles.plain-h1: no 84px underline on the default-content h1 only; h2s keep it
sectionStyles.no-collapse: default content is a flex column: adjacent title/text margins never collapse (source aem-Grid columns are BFCs)
sectionStyles.article-lead: article lead image 12/12: inline img, 7px above/below
sectionStyles.article-body: article body 8/12 (>=1025, in the 1164px container), flex column, guttered titles/images, h1 plain, p.image-caption 14px/600 uppercase −3.5px
sectionStyles.article-aside: article aside 3/12 offset 1 (>=1025), floated right, stacked; full width <=1024

structuralCss: body{display:none} / body.appear; header{height:var(--nav-height)} + header .header visibility until [data-block-status=loaded]; body > header fixed, main padding-top var(--nav-height) (200 / 130 <=1024), main + body > footer capped at 1680; main > .section scaffold (wrappers 1164 >=1025, 14px gutters) — styles/styles.css
headings: h1 40 / h2 36 / h3 24 / h4 16 / h5 14 (canon); a promoted hero title (R-01 / R-02) keeps its h2 size through its block's own class rule — never through the element rule. Every default-content h1/h2 carries the 84px yellow underline (main .default-content-wrapper h1/h2::after) unless the section carries `plain-title` (h1 + h2) or `plain-h1` (h1 only).

locale.rule: getLocale() in scripts/scripts.js: the first two path segments /{country}/{language} (lower-case, two letters each); <html lang> = {language}-{COUNTRY} (en-US when the path has no locale)

chromeSelection.rule: getChromePath(name) in scripts/scripts.js, used by blocks/header (nav) and blocks/footer (footer): 1) page metadata `nav` / `footer` wins (author override); 2) else the locale root's own document `<root>/nav`, `<root>/footer` (any locale except /us/en); 3) else `/nav`, `/footer` (en-US, drafts, any non-locale page). A missing locale document falls back to `/nav` / `/footer`.
chromeSelection.derivedFromPage: current-page markers (link to the current page → aria-current=page; level-1 item whose link is an ancestor of the path → li.is-active; header, mobile nav, footer); toggle flag from the authored locale label (en-CA → /icons/flags/CA.svg); active locale link href = the current page; same-language locale links (en-US <-> en-CA) upgraded to the current page's counterpart on the first menu open when `<counterpart>.plain.html` answers HEAD 200, else the locale home
chromeSelection.navDocumentSections: 0 account (Welcome / Sign In / Sign Out) · 1 language (toggle label + country list) · 2 brand logo · 3 nav (ul > li Home|locale name [> ul level-1]; coming-soon: level-0 item only) · 4 search · 5 metadata (Robots noindex)
chromeSelection.footerDocumentSections: 0 brand logo · 1 nav (as header) · 2 social (h4 Follow Us + ul) · 3 legal paragraphs (/ca/en: Canadian note first) · 4 metadata (Robots noindex)

signIn.document: /fragments/sign-in (one for every locale, as the source's language-masters/en experience fragment)
signIn.code: blocks/header/sign-in.js — prefetched after the header decorates; the modal lives inside the header block, fixed to the viewport, hidden at rest
signIn.sections:
0: h2 Sign In (h1-sized, underlined — the modal adds no second h1) · h3 Welcome Back · one

per field label (a /password/ label → password field) · link

s, the LAST one = the SIGN IN control (href = landing target) · 1: metadata (Robots noindex)
signIn.d1Interim: no auth backend: inputs carry no name, submission is always prevented, Enter / SIGN IN navigate (plain GET, no credentials) to the authored target /us/en/errors/sign-in?resource=%2F&j_reason=invalid_login&j_reason_code=invalid_login — the source's invalid-login landing page (capture gap: not in the inventory)
signIn.behaviour: click or Enter on Sign In → fade in 300 ms; any outside click (the trigger included) → fade out 200 ms and is swallowed; focus stays on the trigger; no scroll lock; Escape does not close (as live)

media.ledgerNote: use --ledger stardust/deploy/media-ledger-wknd.json for every wknd upload: the default stardust/deploy/media-ledger.json holds the 2026-10-16 pilot's edsmsm uploads, and da-media-upload.mjs keys entries by media path only — a media/home/* re-upload against it is SKIPPED and prints the edsmsm URL
media.decorative: flags are code-served /icons/flags/<CC>.svg (CSS backgrounds), never DA media
